title: Encode String With Shortest Length
description: Encode a string into the shortest possible string by recursively compressing repeating patterns.
pseudocode:
1. dp[n][n]
2. for len from 1 to n:
3.   for i from 0 to n - len:
4.     j = i + len - 1
5.     dp[i][j] = s.substring(i, j + 1)
6.     for k from i to j-1:
7.       dp[i][j] = min(dp[i][j], dp[i][k] + dp[k+1][j])
8.     for m from 1 to len:
9.       if len % m == 0 and (s.substring(i, j+1) is composed of repeats of length m):
10.        dp[i][j] = min(dp[i][j], (len/m) + '[' + dp[i][i+m-1] + ']')
